text: I run a two-person bakery and we run out of flour every week.
Spreadsheets take too long to update after a busy morning.
Is there a simple tool that reminds us before an ingredient runs out?
StockPal is built for restaurant chains and is overkill for us.
We lose about three hours each week counting stock by hand.
Our salon double-books appointments every Saturday.
Parents never know which tutoring slot is free.
The cheapest plan costs more than our monthly flour order.
Many reviewers ask for a cheaper plan aimed at home bakers.
What small bakeries need is low-stock alerts and expiry reminders.
I would happily pay a small monthly fee for this.
Barcode scanning does not help because we buy flour in bulk sacks.
Setup took a full weekend and support never answered.
Several owners in my area have the same problem with dairy waste.
Excel crashes when the sheet gets too big.
